record.question: Priority nursing management after the surgery for retinal detachment is:
record.explanation: Answer A: Prevent increase in IOP. Postoperative care after retinal-detachment repair aims to protect the repair and avoid rises in intraocular pressure; positioning and activity restrictions depend on the procedure and surgeon. Source/context note: Specific positioning and restrictions are procedure-specific; follow the surgeon’s instructions. Reference: https://www.nei.nih.gov/learn-about-eye-health/eye-conditions-and-diseases/retinal-detachment. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
